modelOverview: The Royal Oak 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin is the purest expression of Gerald Genta's 1972 original, an ultra-slim 39mm automatic that keeps the exact case dimensions of the very first Royal Oak. In 2022 Audemars Piguet replaced the long-running reference 15202 with reference 16202, introducing the new in-house self-winding Calibre 7121 while preserving the 8.1mm case height and integrated tapisserie-dial aesthetic. The line has since expanded from steel into precious-metal, gem-set and titanium/BMG executions.

16202ST.OO.1240ST.02.description: The steel 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin ref. 16202ST is the everyday hero of the Royal Oak line, carrying the iconic blue 'Bleu Nuit, Nuage 50' tapisserie dial in an 8.1mm ultra-thin case. It debuted in 2022 alongside the new Calibre 7121, replacing the celebrated 15202. Sourced and fully authenticated.

This ultra-rare, entirely set Royal Oak transforms the icon into a jewellery piece. Sourced and fully authenticated.

16202BC.OO.1240BC.02.description: The white gold 'Jumbo' Extra-Thin ref. 16202BC pairs the ultra-thin 8.1mm case with a distinctive grained (grainy-effect) blue dial rather than the usual tapisserie, giving a discreet precious-metal take on the icon. Its understated white gold looks deceptively like steel to the untrained eye. Sourced and fully authenticated.

Introduced in 2023, it marries the icon's classic proportions with cutting-edge materials. Sourced and fully authenticated.
